title_zh: GeoUniPR：一种几何一致性的统一跨模态地点识别框架
title_en: GeoUniPR: A Geometry-Consistent Unified Framework for Cross-Modal Place Recognition
summary_zh: 跨模态地点识别旨在跨异构感知模态（如视觉与LiDAR）识别同一地点。GeoUniPR通过将LiDAR点云投影至相机视角构建几何一致的深度图像视图，实现RGB与LiDAR的直接对应，融合强度及表面法线等原生LiDAR特征，提升结构一致性。利用两个结构相同的ViT编码器，在无辅助对齐模块、多阶段训练及完全微调的情况下，通过参数高效适配学习统一嵌入空间。引入空间一致性InfoNCE对比损失抑制空间连续性导致的假负例。KITTI及KITTI-360测试表明，GeoUniPR在同模态及跨模态地点识别中达到最新性能，并具备良好跨数据集泛化能力。
summary_en: Cross-modal place recognition identifies the same location across different sensing modalities such as vision and LiDAR. GeoUniPR projects LiDAR point clouds into the camera perspective to create geometry-consistent depth image views, establishing direct RGB-LiDAR correspondence. It augments these views with native LiDAR cues like intensity and surface normals to enhance structural consistency. Using two modality-specific ViT encoders with identical architectures, GeoUniPR learns a unified embedding space through parameter-efficient adaptation without auxiliary alignment modules, multi-stage training, or full backbone fine-tuning. It also introduces Spatially-Consistent InfoNCE to reduce distance-induced false negatives. Experiments on KITTI and KITTI-360 show GeoUniPR achieves state-of-the-art results in both same-modal and cross-modal place recognition with strong cross-dataset generalization.
why_it_matters_zh: GeoUniPR创新性地通过几何一致性视角处理跨模态差异，简化训练流程且提升性能，解决了传统方法复杂且资源消耗大的缺点，推动跨模态地点识别技术发展。
why_it_matters_en: GeoUniPR innovatively tackles cross-modal discrepancies through geometry consistency, simplifying training while enhancing performance. It addresses the complexity and resource demands of prior methods, advancing cross-modal place recognition technology.

title_zh: 自我进化的代码-图像推理
summary_zh: 多模态模型在解决视觉任务时越来越多地使用工具（裁剪、缩放、旋转、调亮），这被称为图像思考。核心挑战在于感知：工具揭示视觉证据，推理则依赖语言，大多数目标是人类可以直观判断的。然而，有些视觉问题需要执行多步视觉算法，单靠语言描述算法无法运行。Code-with-Image方法让模型通过Python解释器实现真实的视觉算法，程序本身即为推理。模型通过无训练的反思循环自我学习，修正失败程序，保留有效技能。在Code-with-Image基准测试中，即便是GPT-5.6-luna无工具思考准确率低于30%，使用裸解释器达43%，通过自我进化技能达到67%。开放的27B模型同样表现出显著提升。代码承载推理，使得调试代码即调试推理过程。
summary_en: Multimodal models increasingly use tools like cropping, zooming, rotating, and brightening to solve visual tasks, known as thinking-with-images. The main challenge is perception: tools expose visual evidence while reasoning is in language, suitable for tasks humans can visually inspect. Some questions require multi-step visual algorithms that language alone can describe but not run. The Code-with-Image approach gives the model only a Python interpreter to implement true visual algorithms as code, making the program the reasoning itself. The bottleneck moves from code execution to choosing which algorithm to implement. Models teach themselves via a training-free reflection loop that studies failed programs, tests fixes, and retains successful skills. On the Code-with-Image Bench, GPT-5.6-luna improves from below 30% (no tools) to 43% (bare interpreter) to 67% (with evolved skills). An open 27B model shows similar gains. Code carrying reasoning allows debugging reasoning by debugging code.
why_it_matters_zh: 这项工作突破了传统多模态模型仅在语言中推理的限制，直接用代码实现视觉算法，使模型能够执行复杂的视觉推理任务。通过让模型自我反思和无监督进化，显著提升了性能和技能的迁移能力，推动了视觉推理与代码执行的深度融合。
why_it_matters_en: This work overcomes the limitation of multimodal models reasoning only in language by implementing true visual algorithms in code, enabling complex visual reasoning tasks. By allowing models to self-reflect and evolve skills without supervision, it significantly improves performance and transferability, advancing deep integration of visual reasoning with code execution.

summary_zh: 本文提出了SAPO，一种分段自动提示优化方法。它将提示分解为角色、上下文、任务和输出格式四个模块，通过针对性地优化这些模块，改善提示性能。对GPT-3.5-Turbo和GPT-4o-mini在多个数据集上的评测显示，SAPO优于多种零样本和强基线方法。
summary_en: This paper presents SAPO, a segment-level Automatic Prompt Optimization method that decomposes prompts into role, context, tasks, and output format for targeted improvements. Evaluations on GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4o-mini across multiple datasets show that SAPO outperforms zero-shot and strong APO baselines.

title_zh: 流程图工程中的大语言模型：从最优PFD到验证过的P&ID
title_en: LLMs in Process Diagram Engineering: From Optimal PFDs to Validated P&IDs
summary_zh: 当前流程流图（PFD）的创建及其转化为管道仪表图（P&ID）主要是手工完成。本文提出了P&ID Pilot，一个端到端的AI流程，第一阶段合成PFD，第二阶段将PFD转为P&ID。结合遗传算法与大语言模型的方法生成了最优有效的PFD，满足流量参数且无违规。基于LLM的代理成功将PFD转化为可执行且合规的P&ID，实现100%执行成功。该统一流程显著减少人工工作，实现流程设计自动化。
summary_en: The creation of process flow diagrams (PFD) and their conversion to piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&ID) is largely manual. This research introduces P&ID Pilot, an end-to-end AI pipeline: synthesizing PFDs using a hybrid genetic algorithm and large language model approach to achieve optimal valid topologies, then transforming PFDs into validated executable P&IDs via an LLM-based agent with 100% execution success. This unified pipeline reduces manual engineering effort and enables automated, validated end-to-end process design.
why_it_matters_zh: 该研究展示了如何结合遗传算法和大语言模型，实现从PFD设计到P&ID验证的全流程自动化，显著提升工程效率和设计准确性，推动流程图工程智能化发展。
why_it_matters_en: This work demonstrates how combining genetic algorithms with large language models can automate the entire pipeline from PFD synthesis to validated P&ID transformation, greatly improving engineering efficiency and accuracy, thus advancing intelligent process diagram engineering.

title_zh: CCSK中的弱双模拟关系研究
summary_zh: 本文研究了CCSK（一种CCS的可逆扩展）中不同类型的双模拟关系，包括强/弱、仅前向/可逆，并重点比较它们的异同。特别地，针对文献中未曾探讨的弱可逆双模拟，提出了两个变体：方向性双模拟和混合双模拟，区别在于$\tau$动作是否需与匹配动作保持相同方向（前向/后向）。结果表明，混合双模拟是一种保持合取性的关系，且完全抽象化了$\tau$动作。
summary_en: This paper studies various notions of bisimilarity (strong/weak, forward-only/reversible) in the context of CCSK, a reversible extension of CCS. It highlights their differences and commonalities. In particular, for the weak reversible case not previously studied, two variants are proposed: directional and mixed bisimilarity, depending on whether $\tau$ actions must be in the same direction (forward/backward) as the matched action. It is shown that mixed bisimilarity is a congruence and fully abstracts away from $\tau$ actions.
why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次系统地探讨了CCSK中弱可逆双模拟的两种变体，丰富了可逆计算模型的理论基础，对理解并验证可逆过程的行为具有重要意义。
why_it_matters_en: This work systematically explores two variants of weak reversible bisimilarity in CCSK for the first time, enriching the theoretical foundation of reversible computation models and providing important insights for reasoning about reversible process behaviors.

title_zh: CT-ΔBench：用于纵向三维医学影像差异报告的基准测试与视觉语言模型
title_en: CT-ΔBench: A Benchmark for Longitudinal 3D Medical Imaging Difference Reporting with Vision-Language Models
summary_zh: CT影像在医学中不仅展示疾病的当前状态，更关键的是通过比较同一患者不同时间的序列扫描，评估疾病的发展，支持响应评估、复发检测及病人管理。然而，现有医学基础模型多仅聚焦单次扫描，缺乏对时间序列对比的支持。本文引入CT-ΔBench基准，专注于纵向影像差异报告，即利用两次时间间隔的扫描生成临床上有意义的变化描述报告，同时开发了捕捉临床纵向变化的指标并通过医生验证，提出DeltaMed模型为差异报告提供基线，推动具备时间敏感能力的医学基础模型的发展。
summary_en: Computed Tomography (CT) provides not only current disease snapshots but also enables longitudinal comparison critical for tracking disease evolution, response, recurrence, and management. Existing medical foundation models predominantly handle single studies, lacking temporal cross-examination ability. This work presents CT-ΔBench, a benchmark for longitudinal imaging difference reporting, where models analyze two temporally separated scans from the same patient to generate clinically relevant change reports. The authors develop change-aware metrics, conduct physician validation, compare direct versus two-stage reasoning pipelines, and propose DeltaMed as a baseline model. These contributions advance temporally aware foundation models aligned with real-world longitudinal clinical reasoning.
why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次系统地构建了纵向医学影像差异报告的标准数据集和评价指标，解决了当前模型对时间序列信息理解不足的问题，推动了医学AI在动态疾病监测和管理领域的实际应用发展。
why_it_matters_en: This study systematically builds a benchmark dataset and metrics for longitudinal medical imaging difference reporting, addressing the current gap in models’ temporal understanding. It advances AI applications for dynamic disease monitoring and patient management in clinical practice.
